assertions.claim: 2024: 6.106 million marriages registered (about 20% fewer than the prior year), 3.513 million divorces handled
assertions.cn_span: 2024 年全国办理结婚登记 610.6 万对，比上一年少了两成，办理离婚 351.3 万对

assertions.claim: The viral 'divorce rate over half' just divides the two counts (~57.5%); numerator and denominator are not the same people; the indicator is absent from the communiqué; cannot be read as 'half of marriages end in divorce'
assertions.cn_span: 网上传的「离婚率过半」是拿这两个数一除（约 57.5%），分子分母根本不是同一批人，公报里没有这个指标，不能读成「一半婚姻会离」

assertions.claim: Marriage rate 4.3‰ and divorce rate 2.5‰ use the whole population as denominator, not the married population
assertions.cn_span: 公报里的结婚率 4.3‰、离婚率 2.5‰，分母是全体人口而不是已婚人口

assertions.claim: 'Probability that a given marriage ends in divorce' requires cohort data; no official source found for this section
assertions.cn_span: 「一段婚姻最终离婚的概率」需要队列数据，本节未找到官方原文

assertions.claim: The communiqué notes the crude-rate formula: annual marriages(divorces) / mid-year total population x 1000‰
assertions.cn_span: 公报注明结（离）婚率 = 当年结（离）婚对数 / 当年平均总人口数 × 1000‰，是「粗率」，分母是全体人口而不是已婚人口
